title: Extracting information from a superradiant burst using simple measurements
summary: It is well known that superradiant decay of an ensemble of $N$ spins generates a complex non-classical state of light. Here, we consider the information content of a superradiant burst of photons: how is information encoded in the initial spin state distributed among the emitted photons, and can it be extracted using simple measurements?
